plugin.name: AIMES Form Demo
plugin.description: Build Vue form demos with bundled mock data and an AIMES menu entry without replacing other modules' real backends.
team.demo.name: Quick Dev
team.demo.description: Lead, requirements, developer, tester, deployer. Rapid frontend form delivery: preview locally, deploy the frontend package only.
agent.demo.name: Lead
agent.demo.description: Talks with the user, routes tasks, and reports member results.
agent.requirements.name: Requirements
agent.requirements.description: Defines the list, form, field types, and core business flow.
agent.prototype.name: Developer
agent.prototype.description: Implements the form pages and the AIMES qiankun integration.
agent.tester.name: Tester
agent.tester.description: Checks builds and reviews code, with unit tests only as needed and no interaction testing.
agent.deployer.name: Deployer
agent.deployer.description: Integrates an authorized private branch, builds the frontend package only (no jar replacement or service restart), and delivers an AIMES test deployment card.
